topics.title: Bacterial Structures: Anatomy & Function
topics.productionRationale: The structure-function table (flagellum, pilus, capsule, spore, peptidoglycan, endotoxin/LPS, porin) — the anatomical vocabulary every later organism entry uses.

topics.title: Stains & Difficult-to-Stain Organisms
topics.productionRationale: Gram stain as first-line ID plus the poor-stainers (treponemes too thin, mycobacteria lipid-rich, mycoplasma wall-less, intracellular legionella/rickettsia/chlamydia) — why each fails.

topics.title: Special Culture Requirements
topics.productionRationale: The bug-to-medium directory (chocolate, Thayer-Martin, Bordet-Gengou, Löwenstein-Jensen, etc.) plus lactose fermentation — the lab-identification spine.

topics.title: Anaerobes, Aerobes & Oxygen Tolerance
topics.productionRationale: The oxygen-tolerance spectrum (obligate anaerobes lack catalase/SOD; facultative, obligate aerobic, microaerophilic, facultative-intracellular) with the aminoglycoside-needs-O2 corollary.

topics.title: Catalase, Pigment, Spore & Encapsulation Groups
topics.productionRationale: The trait-group directories: catalase-positive organisms (the CGD set), pigmented bugs (Actinomyces sulfur granules, S aureus gold, Pseudomonas pyocyanin), and spore formers.

topics.title: Virulence Mechanisms & Antimicrobial Resistance Overview
topics.productionRationale: The immune-evasion directory (capsule, protein A, IgA proteases) plus the resistance-mechanisms table (efflux, decreased uptake, enzymatic inactivation, target modification) — E38's complement and E32's CGD loops closed.

topics.title: Bacterial Genetics: Transformation, Conjugation, Transduction
topics.productionRationale: The three horizontal gene-transfer routes (transformation with competence, conjugation with sex pilus, transduction general/specialized) plus transposons — how resistance and virulence spread.

topics.title: Exotoxins vs Endotoxins
topics.productionRationale: The classic comparison (source, chemistry, genes, effects, vaccines, heat stability) plus the major exotoxin table (ADP-ribosylators, superantigens, clostridial toxins) and endotoxin's TNF/IL-1/IL-6 cascade to septic shock.

topics.title: Gram-Positive Cocci: Staphylococcus & Streptococcus
topics.productionRationale: The catalase/coagulase/hemolysis decision tree splitting staphylococci (aureus vs epidermidis vs saprophyticus) from streptococci (pyogenes, agalactiae, pneumoniae, viridans, enterococci) — the most-tested organism block in bacteriology.

topics.title: Gram-Positive Bacilli: Clostridia, Corynebacterium, Listeria, Actinomyces, Nocardia
topics.productionRationale: The spore-forming clostridia (tetani, botulinum, perfringens, difficile) with their toxin mechanics, plus the aerobic diphtheroids (diphtheriae ADP-ribosylation, Listeria cold-growth motility, Actinomyces vs Nocardia).

topics.title: Mycobacteria: Tuberculosis & Leprosy
topics.productionRationale: TB's primary-reactivation-miliary spectrum with ghon complex and caseation, the lepromatous-tuberculoid leprosy axis, and the acid-fast staining logic — cytokine-tied (E31's IFN-γ/IL-12 axis).

topics.title: Gram-Negative Bacilli: Enterics & Zoonotics
topics.productionRationale: The enteric and zoonotic gram-negatives: Neisseria (gonococci/meningococci), Haemophilus, Brucella/Legionella/Pasteurella/Bordetella, and the lactose-fermenter split of the ENTERICS.

topics.title: Enteric Pathogens: Salmonella, Shigella, E. coli Strains & Campylobacter
topics.productionRationale: The typhoidal-vs-nontyphoidal salmonella, shigella invasiveness, the E. coli strain roster (EPEC, EHEC, ETEC, EIEC), and Campylobacter — GI microbiology's core comparison table.

topics.title: Spirochetes: Treponema, Borrelia, Leptospira
topics.productionRationale: The three spirochetes plus syphilis's primary-secondary-tertiary staging with congenital transmission and the nontreponemal-vs-treponemal testing logic (RPR/VDRL vs FTA-ABS/TP-PA).

topics.title: Intracellular & Vector-Borne Bacteria: Chlamydia, Rickettsia, Mycoplasma
topics.productionRationale: The obligate-intracellular set (chlamydiae life cycle, rickettsiae), the vector-borne roster (RMSF, typhus, ehrlichiosis, anaplasmosis, plague, tularemia), and the rash-common/rash-rare split.

topics.title: Systemic Mycoses: Histoplasma, Blastomyces, Coccidioides, Paracoccidioides
topics.productionRationale: The endemic-mycosis quartet with geography, tissue forms, and presentations (Histoplasma Ohio valleys intracellular, Blastomyces broad-based budding, Coccidioides arthroconidia, Paracoccidioides Latin America).

topics.title: Opportunistic Fungi: Aspergillus, Cryptococcus, Candida, Mucor
topics.productionRationale: The opportunistic mycoses: Aspergillus (angioinvasive, halo sign), Cryptococcus (India ink, capsule, meningitis), Candida (pseudohyphae), Mucor (ketoacidosis rhinocerebral) — E38's granulocyte column.

topics.title: Intestinal & Urogenital Protozoa
topics.productionRationale: The GI/UG protozoa: Giardia (duodenal trophozoites, IgA-deficiency), Entamoeba histolytica (erythrocyte-eating flask ulcers), Cryptosporidium (AIDS), Trichomonas (strawberry cervix).

topics.title: Blood & Tissue Protozoa: Plasmodium, Babesia, Toxoplasma, Trypanosoma, Leishmania
topics.productionRationale: Malaria's species-cycle-drug triad, Babesia (maltese cross, asplenia), Toxoplasma (TORCH, cats), the trypanosomiases (Chagas vs sleeping sickness) and leishmaniasis — the vector-hosted protozoa.

topics.title: Nematodes: The Roundworms
topics.productionRationale: The intestinal and tissue roundworms: Ascaris, Hookworm (Necator/Ancylostoma), Strongyloides (autoinfection, hyperinfection in steroid/HTLV-1), Enterobius (pinworm, Scotch tape), Trichinella, Onchocerca, Loa, Wucheraria (elephantiasis).

topics.title: Cestodes & Trematodes: Tapeworms and Flukes
topics.productionRationale: The tapeworms (Taenia solium/saginata, cysticercosis, Diphyllobothrium B12, Echinococcus hydatid) and flukes (Schistosoma species, Clonorchis, Paragonimus, Fasciola) plus ectoparasites (scabies, lice).

topics.title: Viral Structure & Genetics
topics.productionRationale: Capsid symmetries, envelope vs naked (the GI/environment logic), genomes, plus recombination-reassortment-complementation and the Baltimore-ish DNA/RNA family rosters.

topics.title: DNA Viruses: Families & Disease Map
topics.productionRationale: The DNA-virus family table (ds/SS, envelope, medical importance) plus the herpesvirus subfamily roster (HSV, VZV, EBV, CMV, HHV-6/8) with latency sites and the virus-receptor list (CD21, CD4/CXCR4/CCR5, ACE2).

topics.title: RNA Viruses: Families & Disease Map
topics.productionRationale: The RNA-virus family table (the PERCH picnic, arboviruses, orthomyxo vs paramyxo segmentation) plus measles-mumps-rubella, picornaviruses, rotavirus, and the genetic-shift/drift map (E34's vaccine logic).

topics.title: Viral Vaccines, Diagnosis & Emerging Viruses
topics.productionRationale: The live-vs-killed vaccine split (E34's chapter applied), viral diagnostics, the SARS-CoV-2 structure-and-drug anchor, and prions (PrPsc conformational change, spongiform encephalopathies).

topics.title: Hepatitis Viruses: A Through E
topics.productionRationale: The five-virus comparison (transmission, incubation, course, HCC risk) and the HBV serology timeline (HBsAg/anti-HBs/HBcAg/anti-HBc/HBeAg windows) — serology's most-tested chart.

topics.title: HIV & AIDS: Virology Through Opportunists
topics.productionRationale: HIV's structure, lifecycle (E40's drug targets), diagnosis (NAT/4th-gen), the CD4-staged opportunist map (Pneumocystis, CMV CREEP, MAC, cryptococcosis, Kaposi) — virology's clinical capstone.

topics.title: Normal Flora & Colonization
topics.productionRationale: The body-site flora directory (skin Staph epidermidis, nose Staph aureus, colon anaerobes/E coli, vagina Lactobacillus) with the sterile-site list.

topics.title: Bugs by System: GI, Pneumonia, Meningitis & CSF
topics.productionRationale: The age-split pathogen tables (meningitis newborns-to-elderly, pneumonia by age and setting) and the CSF formula (bacterial/fungal/viral) — systems-based organism matching.

topics.title: Bugs by System: Rash, STDs, TORCH & Nosocomial
topics.productionRationale: The vesicular-petechial rash roster, the STD directory, TORCH maternal-neonatal manifestations, UTI/osteomyelitis/water-bite/cellulitis associations, and the classic-bug-by-presentation capstone table.

topics.title: Antimicrobial Mechanisms: The Target Map
topics.productionRationale: The mechanism-of-action map (cell wall, protein synthesis, DNA/RNA, folate, membrane) with the antibacterial-class directory — E40's immunosuppressant map's infectious-disease sibling.

topics.title: Cell Wall Inhibitors: Penicillins, Cephalosporins, Carbapenems, Vancomycin
topics.productionRationale: The beta-lactam family tree (penicillinase-sensitive/resistant, antipseudomonal, the cephalosporin generations with the 3rd-gen ceftriaxone/ceftazidime anchors) plus carbapenems, aztreonam, and vancomycin.

topics.title: Protein Synthesis Inhibitors: 30S, 50S & Beyond
topics.productionRationale: The 30S/50S inhibitor roster with the initiation/elongation/termination map (aminoglycosides' bactericidal initiation error vs tetracyclines' blocking), macrolides/linezolid, and polymyxins' membrane mechanism.

topics.title: DNA/RNA & Folate Pathway Inhibitors
topics.productionRationale: Sulfonamides/trimethoprim's sequential folate blockade (the synergistic TMP-SMX logic), fluoroquinolones' DNA gyrase, daptomycin's membrane, and metronidazole's anaerobe activation.

topics.title: Antimycobacterial Therapy
topics.productionRationale: RIPE regimen with mechanisms (INH mycolic acid synthesis, ethambutol arabinogalactan, PZA intracellular, rifampin RNA polymerase), toxicities (INH peripheral neuropathy/B6, ethambutol color blindness), and prophylaxis rules.

topics.title: Antifungal Agents
topics.productionRationale: The ergosterol-pathway map (amphotericin's pore, azoles' 14α-demethylase, the nephrotoxicity sign-off) plus echinocandins' glucan synthesis, flucytosine, terbinafine, and griseofulvin's keratin logic.

topics.title: Antiparasitic & Non-HIV Antiviral Agents
topics.productionRationale: The antihelminthics/antiprotozoals (praziquantel, ivermectin, mebendazole, chloroquine), the non-HIV antivirals (ganciclovir CMV, baloxavir/remdesivir influenza/COVID), disinfection methods, and pregnancy-contraindicated antimicrobials.

topics.title: HIV Therapy: NRTIs Through Integrase Inhibitors
topics.productionRationale: The HIV drug classes mapped to the lifecycle (entry: maraviroc/enfuvirtide; RT: NRTIs/NNRTIs; integrase: bictegravir/dolutegravir; protease: atazanavir/darunavir) with the toxicities (ZDV marrow, abacavir HLA-B*5701) and prophylaxis rules.

topics.title: Hepatitis C Therapy: DAAs
topics.productionRationale: The direct-acting antiviral classes on the HCV lifecycle (NS5A elbasvir/ledipasvir, NS5B sofosbuvir, NS3/4A glecaprevir/grazoprevir, ribavirin) — the therapy that demoted E41's IFN-α to 'not preferred.'

notes: Phase I-C inventory built from the heading census (micro-heading-census.json) + banner structure. Continuation pages without banners (153, 159-160, 162, 166, 173, 191-192) are assigned to their owning topics. p143 is the chapter opener. The cataloged p219 disinfection block and pregnancy-contra list are folded into antiparasitic-antiviral; normal-flora p196 is split between prions (viral-vaccines-diagnostics claims 196 for prions; normal-flora claims 196 for flora — page shared, distinct subsections).
